scope: Jesus has six distinct body pictures; Look Unto Me has five.

placements.title: Meet the risen Savior
placements.description: A devotional interpretation of Christ among the people at Bountiful. Read the account of His invitation to come forward, and notice how each person is invited to witness for themselves.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a charcoal mantle extending an open hand toward an elderly man in a courtyard

placements.title: Notice His pattern of prayer
placements.description: This devotional interpretation accompanies Luke’s account of Jesus withdrawing to pray. Consider how making room for prayer could shape a day of following Him.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a muted aubergine robe praying quietly beside an olive tree, a devotional interpretation

placements.title: Make room for children
placements.description: A devotional interpretation of Christ welcoming children. Mark records His insistence that they be allowed to come to Him. Read the encounter and consider whose voice might need more room in your own conversations.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ in a petrol-teal robe listening warmly to children in a village courtyard

placements.title: Bring fear into the conversation
placements.description: A devotional interpretation of the storm on the Sea of Galilee. Read what the disciples ask and how Jesus responds. This account invites study of His identity; it does not set a timetable for relief from every trial.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ wearing a textured sand-gray mantle with a brown woven edge, seated in a wooden boat and listening to a young disciple

placements.title: Keep the revelation beside its setting
placements.description: An illustrative rural setting, not an identified photograph of Harmony. Keep the historical introduction beside the revelation as you read.
placements.alt: An interpretive rural lane approaching a modest early nineteenth-century farmhouse

placements.title: Turn attention toward Christ
placements.description: A devotional image of Christ accompanying the invitation to look to Him. Read that invitation beside the surrounding encouragement to faithful action and remembrance.
placements.alt: Jesus Christ facing the viewer with a calm attentive expression, a devotional interpretation

placements.title: Let an honest question remain visible
placements.description: A contemporary study illustration. Write what remains uncertain and return to the passage without pretending the question has disappeared.
placements.alt: A woman recording a question beside an open book at a quiet overlook

placements.title: Talk about what you are learning
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of conversation in daily life. Use the invitation to talk of Christ as a starting point for sharing what you noticed.
placements.alt: A father and adult daughter talking during an ordinary household task

placements.title: Let study lead to something good
placements.description: A contemporary illustration of practical help. Choose one good action that fits another person's needs and your circumstances.
placements.alt: A neighbor helping repair a small garden gate
